purpose: Explain residual failure after the fixed primary comparisons; not change group definitions or tune any parameter
scope: Only 121 selected D nonempty collisions and 164 GT-feasible angle variants rejected by original EG CD, from existing 14748 poses
compute: Collision-volume occupancy and assigned-object/other-object/table attribution; exact official GT static masks and original EG swept masks; no force-closure evaluation
checks: Geometric GT mask reproduces existing static collision labels; observed EG occupancy reproduces previously recorded original detector global occupancy
interpretation: Observed points in the same GT static collision solid distinguish missing sampled support from volume/threshold mismatch; absence is not proof of occlusion. Full GT occupancy in EG static/sweep volumes indicates different collision definitions, not necessarily a sensor error.
